title: Cabinet Studio PostgreSQL Schema v1
enum_strategy: TEXT + named CHECK constraints (not PostgreSQL ENUM types)
pk_strategy: public_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY with opaque prefixed ids; no serial API ids
timestamps: TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now() UTC

conventions.public_pk: public_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY prefixed opaque string
conventions.fk_enforcement: real FOREIGN KEY constraints + transactions for multi-row invariants
conventions.soft_delete: status/state columns; no physical DELETE of tenant rows
conventions.scale: managed Postgres (Neon/RDS) + read replica later; no Citus for v1

users.purpose: Human identity, credentials, legal acceptance, account lifecycle. User-owned.

oauth_identities.purpose: Link a user to one social/SSO subject per provider. No provider tokens.

organizations.purpose: Cabinet business, billing boundary, shared-data owner. Trial starts at create (14d). Soft-delete via status.

memberships.purpose: User-organization relationship with role and lifecycle state. Unique (organization_id, user_id).

columns.name: state
columns.notes: CHECK invited|active|suspended|removed; API projects as status

invitations.purpose: Time-limited single-use org join offer. token_hash only; never raw token.

devices.purpose: Activated Cabinet Studio installation. Max 3 active per user. No fingerprints.

sessions.purpose: Rotating refresh-token family. Reuse sets reuse_detected_at and revokes the family. Access JWTs not stored.

email_tokens.purpose: Single-use hashed tokens for email verify, password reset, email change. Cleanup on expires_at.

oauth_states.purpose: Short-lived CSRF/PKCE state. Cleanup 10 minutes. unique state.

device_codes.purpose: RFC 8628 device authorization. unique device_code and user_code. Cleanup 600s.

plans.purpose: Server-side commercial catalog. Seeded. Desktop never hard-codes prices.

columns.name: capabilities
columns.notes: cloud_projects, organization_assets, proposal_branding, engineering_handoff, max_seats, max_devices, max_cloud_projects

subscriptions.purpose: One normalized commercial agreement per organization. No card data. Webhook-verified state is SoT (BIL-002).

invoices.purpose: Local projection of provider invoices. No PAN/CVC. No raw Stripe objects.

billing_events.purpose: Webhook inbox and dedupe. unique (provider, provider_event_id). Redacted summary only. organization_id nullable.

entitlements.purpose: Immutable signed capability snapshots. organization_id nullable if user has no org.

audit_events.purpose: Append-only redacted audit trail. No updates. actor_user_id is API actor_id. organization_id nullable FK.

outbox.purpose: Transactional outbox. published_at null until Kafka ack. Kafka is not SoT. No FK; partition_key is org id string.

columns.name: payload
columns.notes: marshaled cabinet.v1.Envelope protobuf; Kafka value is raw bytes, never JSON

write: all mutating handlers in same Postgres txn as domain write

idempotency_keys.purpose: 24h replay cache. unique (principal, key). Cleanup 24h on created_at. No FK.
idempotency_keys.cleanup: DELETE WHERE created_at < now() - interval '24 hours'

data_exports.purpose: Async personal-data export jobs. Not org-owned projects. User-owned.
data_exports.cleanup: DELETE WHERE expires_at IS NOT NULL AND expires_at < now()

cleanup_jobs.sql: DELETE FROM email_tokens WHERE expires_at < now()
DELETE FROM oauth_states WHERE expires_at < now()
DELETE FROM device_codes WHERE expires_at < now()
DELETE FROM idempotency_keys WHERE created_at < now() - interval '24 hours'
DELETE FROM data_exports WHERE expires_at IS NOT NULL AND expires_at < now()
cleanup_jobs.effect: drop ready archives job rows after retention

cleanup_jobs.sql: DELETE FROM sessions WHERE expires_at < now() - interval '7 days' AND revoked_at IS NOT NULL
cleanup_jobs.effect: optional sweeper; reuse hashes must survive expires_at

transaction_boundaries: POST /v1/organizations: organizations first then memberships + subscriptions + audit_events + outbox
accept invite: invitations + memberships + audit_events + outbox
transfer ownership: organizations + memberships + audit_events + outbox
refresh rotation: sessions insert + presented revoke; reuse revokes family
webhook process+outbox: billing_events + subscriptions/invoices + audit_events + outbox
device activate: devices + entitlements + audit_events + outbox
email change confirm: email_tokens + users + sessions revoke + audit_events + outbox
